select * from `genic_users_v2` where `id` = '2' and `genic_users_v2`.`deleted_at` is null limit 1;

select `text`, `color`, `id`, `type`, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'quotation' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as quotation_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'customer' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as customer_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'supplier' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as supplier_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'enquiry' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as enquiry_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'visit' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as visit_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'parts' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as parts_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'goods' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as goods_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'service' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as service_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'asset' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as asset_equipment_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'tool' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as tool_equipment_count, (SELECT count(id) FROM `genic_tags_v2` WHERE `deleted_at` IS NULL AND `type` = 'client_equipment' AND `tag` = `genic_genric_tags_v2`.`text`) as customer_equipment_count from `genic_genric_tags_v2` where `private` = '0' and `type` = 'visit' group by `text`;

select `genic_roles`.*, `genic_model_has_roles`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `genic_model_has_roles`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `genic_model_has_roles`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type` from `genic_roles` inner join `genic_model_has_roles` on `genic_roles`.`id` = `genic_model_has_roles`.`role_id` where `genic_model_has_roles`.`model_id` = '2' and `genic_model_has_roles`.`model_type` = 'App\Models\V2\User';
